PERMISSIONS.CRM_METAS_MANAGE: See and set the monthly goals
PERMISSIONS.CONVERSATION_VIEW: Reads the other conversations of the inbox
PERMISSIONS.GRANT_ABOVE_OWN: Can grant access above their own
PERMISSIONS.FINANCIAL_MANAGE: Turn the Meta charge authorization on and off
PERMISSIONS.TOKEN_MANAGE: See and rotate tokens and keys

CONVERSATIONS.NAME: Conversations
CONVERSATIONS.LEVEL_LIMITED: Sees conversations assigned to them and the ones they take part in.
CONVERSATIONS.LEVEL_ALL: Sees and answers every conversation in the account.
CONVERSATIONS.LEVEL_VIEW: Reads the conversations of their inboxes, without replying or changing anything.

CONTACTS.NAME: Contacts and companies
CONTACTS.LEVEL_VIEW: Opens and reads contacts. Does not change them.

REPORTS.NAME: Reports
REPORTS.HINT: Overview, CSAT, SLA, bots and teams

CRM.NAME: CRM
CRM.LEVEL_VIEW: Sees the board and cards. Does not change them.

AUTONOMIA.NAME: Autonom.ia agents
AUTONOMIA.LEVEL_VIEW: Opens the agents and chats in the playground.

DESEMPENHO.NAME: Agent performance
DESEMPENHO.HINT: What people look for, results and exports
DESEMPENHO.LEVEL_VIEW: Opens the performance panel, with the numbers of the inboxes they see. Downloading the PDF and spreadsheet also needs Export contacts.

PROSPECTING.NAME: Prospecting
PROSPECTING.LEVEL_MANAGE: Runs searches, enriches and creates leads. This has a cost.
PROSPECTING.SUGGESTION: Sending leads to a campaign also needs Campaigns · Edit.

INSURANCE.NAME: Quotes
INSURANCE.LEVEL_MANAGE: Sets up insurers and the quote agent.

CAMPAIGNS.NAME: Campaigns
CAMPAIGNS.HINT: Email, WhatsApp, SMS, links and QR codes
CAMPAIGNS.LEVEL_MANAGE: Builds campaigns. Sending is the option below.

WHATSAPP_TEMPLATES.NAME: WhatsApp templates
WHATSAPP_TEMPLATES.LEVEL_VIEW: Sees templates and where they are used.
WHATSAPP_TEMPLATES.LEVEL_MANAGE: Creates, changes and deletes templates in WhatsApp.

META_ADS.NAME: Meta ads
META_ADS.LEVEL_VIEW: Sees the ads panel, its results and each ad's budget and dates. Creating, connecting and configuring need Edit.
META_ADS.LEVEL_MANAGE: Also connects, configures and disconnects the ad account, where ads lead, the sales signal in the pipeline and the WhatsApp report, acts on the advisor, creates ads (always paused), activates them and changes their budget and dates.

POSTS.NAME: Your posts
POSTS.HINT: Instagram and Page posts, with their numbers
POSTS.LEVEL_VIEW: Sees the posts and numbers of the Instagram and Page inboxes they see.
POSTS.LEVEL_MANAGE: For now, the same as View. Once the page has comments, also replies, hides and sends the private reply, on the inboxes they see.

INBOXES.NAME: Inboxes
INBOXES.LEVEL_MANAGE: Creates inboxes, reconnects WhatsApp and manages members.

INTEGRATIONS.NAME: Integrations
INTEGRATIONS.HINT: Integrations, webhooks, bots, channel reconnection and tokens
INTEGRATIONS.LEVEL_MANAGE: Connects and disconnects integrations, creates webhooks and bots and reconnects channels. Creating a new inbox stays in Inboxes.
INTEGRATIONS.SUGGESTION: To reconnect a channel, Inboxes needs at least View.

SCHEDULING.NAME: Scheduling
SCHEDULING.HINT: Booking pages and their numbers. Booking a time for a customer needs no permission.
SCHEDULING.LEVEL_VIEW: Sees the booking pages and their numbers.
SCHEDULING.LEVEL_MANAGE: Creates, publishes and pauses booking pages.

MACROS.NAME: Team macros
MACROS.HINT: Personal macros stay available to everyone
MACROS.LEVEL_MANAGE: Creates and publishes macros for the team.

ASSIGNMENT.NAME: Agent assignment
ASSIGNMENT.HINT: Who receives each conversation and how many at a time
ASSIGNMENT.LEVEL_MANAGE: Creates and changes the assignment and capacity rules.
ASSIGNMENT.SUGGESTION: To list every inbox in the forms, Inboxes needs at least View.

PEOPLE.NAME: People
PEOPLE.LEVEL_MANAGE: Invites, edits and removes agents and manages teams. Never touches administrators.

FINANCE.NAME: Finance
FINANCE.HINT: Account costs and the Meta charge authorization
FINANCE.LEVEL_VIEW: Sees the Meta charge authorization and, for whoever also has CRM reports, what AI costs in money. Plan and invoices stay with the administrator.
FINANCE.LEVEL_MANAGE: Also turns the Meta charge authorization on and off.

MOVE.DESCRIPTION: “{name}” will be deleted. Choose the role these people will have from now on.
MOVE.LABEL: New role for these people
MOVE.NO_ROLE_HINT: Sees the CRM like any plain agent
MOVE.NO_ROLE_WARNING: Without a role, they get the access of a plain agent, which sees almost all of the CRM.

EXTRAS.CONVERSATION_UNASSIGNED_MANAGE: Sees the queue of unassigned conversations and can take them.
EXTRAS.CONVERSATION_PARTICIPATING_MANAGE: Sees conversations they take part in, even if assigned to someone else.
EXTRAS.CRM_MOVE_CARDS: Drags cards between stages without editing anything else.
EXTRAS.CRM_VIEW_REPORTS: Pipeline dashboard and AI usage cost.
EXTRAS.CRM_MANAGE_AI: Sets up and accepts AI suggestions. This has a cost.
EXTRAS.CRM_EXPORT: Downloads the list with customer data.
EXTRAS.CRM_DELETE_CARDS: Archives cards, one by one or in bulk.
EXTRAS.CRM_METAS_MANAGE: Sees and sets each person's monthly goal, in money.
EXTRAS.SALES_VALUE_VIEW: Card values, totals, goals and money-based rates. Without this, they see counts and the value of their own cards only.
EXTRAS.CRM_ADMIN: Turns on everything above except sales values, and the CRM SLA. Integration tokens live in Integrations.
EXTRAS.PROSPECTING_VIEW_ALL_SEARCHES: Without this, they only see their own searches.
EXTRAS.CONVERSATION_VIEW: Also reads the inbox conversations they do not handle, without replying.
EXTRAS.CONVERSATION_MESSAGE_DELETE: Deletes messages in the conversations they handle. The attachment is removed and the message shows as deleted.
EXTRAS.CONTACT_EXPORT: Downloads the contact base as a spreadsheet.
EXTRAS.CONTACT_DELETE: Deletes contacts and companies, one by one or in bulk.
EXTRAS.CAMPAIGN_SEND: Sends and schedules campaigns and resumes paused ones. Without this, they build and mark campaigns ready for someone who sends.
EXTRAS.CUSTOM_ROLE_MANAGE: Creates and edits roles, within their own keys.
EXTRAS.GRANT_ABOVE_OWN: Hands out any role in the account, except administrator. Everything goes to the audit log.
EXTRAS.TOKEN_MANAGE: Sees and rotates platform tokens: API and website inboxes, webhooks, bots, CRM tokens and the Google link. Never mints a token stronger than its own role.
